name: Martin Smith
quote: First class work done efficiently and professionally. I have been using Yardley Hastings Garage for 40 years.

name: Gareth Williams
quote: My son's car was involved in an accident and we took it to Yardley Hastings Garage. I cannot speak highly enough of the service, speed and craftsmanship — really happy with the results. Honest, professional, a proper job done.

name: David Fensom
quote: My car needed some bodywork repairs after unfortunately running over a badger. Dwayne and the staff did an extremely good job and kept me informed throughout the entire process.

name: Russell Griffiths
quote: I cannot emphasise enough just how good this garage is — two other garages, including a main dealer, hadn't a clue about my car's problem. Yardley Hastings Garage sorted it out.

name: Carol Ross
quote: I was recommended to use Yardley Hastings Garage for some bodywork repair on my Chevy Camaro. Dom clearly knew exactly what needed to be done, and did a great job.

name: Piet Snyman
quote: Reliable garage, personal service. Highly recommended.

name: Andy Ellis
quote: I stopped to enquire about pre-owned cars and the gent who assisted me was very helpful.

name: Tamsin May
quote: Absolutely brilliant service, thank you Dwane and your team. Very reasonable and thorough — thank you for the lovely touch of washing my car too. We will be back.
